name: Test Copilot GitHub Integration

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cache/go-build
            ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('**/go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-

      - name: Build CLI
        run: go build -o gh-aw ./cmd/...

      - name: Run unit and integration tests
        run: go test ./... -v

      - name: Verify default instruction generation
        run: |
          ./gh-aw compile
          if [ ! -f .github/instructions/github-agentic-workflows.instructions.md ]; then
            echo "Missing instruction file: .github/instructions/github-agentic-workflows.instructions.md"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ ! -f .github/prompts/create-agentic-workflow.prompt.md ]; then
            echo "Missing prompt file: .github/prompts/create-agentic-workflow.prompt.md"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Verify --no-instructions flag
        run: |
          rm -f .github/instructions/github-agentic-workflows.instructions.md
          rm -f .github/prompts/create-agentic-workflow.prompt.md
          ./gh-aw compile --no-instructions
          if [ -f .github/instructions/github-agentic-workflows.instructions.md ]; then
            echo "Instruction file should not be created with --no-instructions"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -f .github/prompts/create-agentic-workflow.prompt.md ]; then
            echo "Prompt file should not be created with --no-instructions"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Verify --no-emit flag skips instructions
        run: |
          rm -f .github/instructions/github-agentic-workflows.instructions.md
          rm -f .github/prompts/create-agentic-workflow.prompt.md
          ./gh-aw compile --no-emit
          if [ -f .github/instructions/github-agentic-workflows.instructions.md ]; then
            echo "Instruction file should not be created with --no-emit"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -f .github/prompts/create-agentic-workflow.prompt.md ]; then
            echo "Prompt file should not be created with --no-emit"
            exit 1
          fi
